patchNotes.title: Event page layout
patchNotes.text: Removed the permanent Current Event side panel and replaced it with a compact active Editing Event banner so the Saved Events library can use the full page width.

patchNotes.title: Lifecycle card surfaces
patchNotes.text: Event cards now receive subtle theme-ready lifecycle tints for Draft, Ready, Scheduled, Due, Live, Archived, and Trash. Editing adds a stronger independent highlight.

patchNotes.title: Event sorting
patchNotes.text: Added Newest, Oldest, Name A-Z, and Name Z-A sorting with numeric Event ID fallback for older records without useful timestamps.

patchNotes.title: Preset Actions
patchNotes.text: Preset cards now use a cleaner View, Actions, and Edit/Copy/Restore layout, and Empty Preset Trash is a compact Trash-only action rather than a permanent full-width danger bar.

patchNotes.title: Category selection
patchNotes.text: Existing Preset categories are shown immediately in a select-or-create field. Newly used categories are remembered immediately in the current UI session.

patchNotes.title: GitHub cache hardening
patchNotes.text: Manual refresh now combines a per-refresh nonce with each GitHub update folder SHA so isolated file edits and visible true/false changes request a fresh remote JSON snapshot.
